headline: Goodbye to the Polish Miracle: Italian Motor Third-Party Liability Insurance to Become Mandatory - News
summary: The new Highway Code will require Italian motor third-party liability insurance, ending the practice of using foreign registration to reduce insurance costs. Police will check Polish databases in real time.
why: Motor third-party liability insurance is compulsory across the EU and priced by insurers based on risk. Rule changes affect insurers' premium income and the cost of motoring.
